name: NeuroAds
task: Website or Shopify chat & FAQ deflection
summary: AI chat widget for Shopify trained on your catalogue, orders and policy pages that replies in the shopper's own language, with rich product cards, discount codes, order tracking and add-to-cart inside the chat. Launched June 2026 with six App Store reviews.
best_for: small and mid-size Shopify stores that want a multilingual, catalogue-aware chat widget with product cards, order tracking and add-to-cart, and want to judge it on the usable free tier of 200 conversations a month
skip_if: you need a support desk with a track record, you cannot budget against a 'conversation' nobody has defined, or routing customer names, phone numbers and addresses through a ten-week-old vendor is not a trade you want to make
honest_knock:
The app is young. It launched on 5 June 2026 and, as of 19 August 2026, had six reviews: all five stars, all posted between 7 and 15 August, by merchants who had had it installed for five, eleven and thirteen days. Nothing about that is suspicious on its face; new apps have new reviews. But six enthusiastic first impressions from people two weeks in tell you the setup is smooth and tell you nothing about what happens when the bot gets a refund question wrong in month four. By 9 October 2026 there were twelve, still all five stars. On the same page, Shopify Inbox is free with 5,488 reviews.

In August the listing contradicted itself on the trial: the summary promised a 30-day trial while the pricing table showed seven days. By 9 October 2026 the summary says only 'Free trial available' and all three paid plans show a 7-day free trial, so plan on seven days and check it in the charge screen.

And look at what it asks for. This app requests names, email addresses, phone numbers and physical addresses of your customers, plus geolocation and IP, sixty days of order history, your discount codes and your store pages. That is a defensible list for a bot that tracks orders and offers codes, and it is also a lot of customer data to route through an app launched in June 2026 on the strength of a dozen reviews. The privacy policy (last updated 10 July 2026) answers part of it: hosting and storage on Amazon Web Services in the US region, order data fetched live rather than stored, and chat transcripts deleted 90 days after a conversation ends. Check that against your own obligations before you switch it on for a store with EU shoppers.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month for 800 conversations, live human takeover and discount codes in chat, billed in USD every 30 days with a 7-day free trial
pricing.notes: (read 2026-08-19 and re-verified unchanged 2026-10-09 on apps.shopify.com/neuroads-chatbot) Four tiers, priced by conversations per month. Free: 200 conversations, AI answers about products, collections and orders, rich product cards with add-to-cart, order status and tracking in chat, replies in the shopper's language. Starter $19 a month: 800 conversations, plus live human takeover and discount codes offered in chat, 7-day free trial. Growth $49 a month or $468 a year (save 20%): 3,000 conversations, plus a revenue and ROAS dashboard, A/B testing on the chat greeting, answer insights and Klaviyo, 7-day free trial. Unlimited $119 a month or $1,142 a year (save 20%): unlimited conversations, WhatsApp and Klaviyo, advanced reporting with CSV export, chat-only discount codes, removal of the 'Powered by NeuroAds' label, a year of conversation history and dedicated onboarding, 7-day free trial. All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days. Two things the pricing table does not settle. What counts as one conversation — a shopper session, a thread, a single message — is defined nowhere, and it is the only unit the whole ladder is built on. On 19 August 2026 the listing summary also advertised a 30-day trial against the table's seven days; on 9 October 2026 the summary says only 'Free trial available' and every paid plan shows a 7-day free trial. Developer NEUROAD VENTURES LLC of Newport Beach, California; the app launched 5 June 2026 and had six App Store reviews on 19 August 2026 and twelve, all five stars, on 9 October 2026.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested NeuroAds Chatbot on a Shopify development store on the Free plan: the install, a store sync of 31 items, a German question in the Playground that got a German answer with a product card (the delivery time stayed vague), a question for a person and a discount code that only got an e-mail field, the Settings page with both features locked to Starter and up, the Billing page with the definition of a chat, and the plan screen where Starter, Growth and Unlimited were Not available on dev stores. No Shopify approval screen was reached and nothing was paid. The chat widget on the shop was not switched on. The app was uninstalled afterwards. Install: the install form on the App Store page was opened in our own tab at 17:55; the first try ended on the list of apps without an install, the second try showed the dialog Install app for NeuroAds Chatbot by NeuroAd Ventures with View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View store data, and Install was clicked at about 17:55. The app opened on Let's bring your assistant to life with a step Sync my store and the line that nothing is shared with shoppers until you are ready. The admin was in English. No card, phone number or account on the vendor site was asked. Core action, a store sync and a chat in another language: at 17:56 Sync my store gave 31 of 31 items enabled, Last synced just now (Products 18, Collections 3, Discounts 5, Policies 1, Pages 4, Blogs 0). A banner said Finish setup: we haven't detected your chat on your storefront yet; the widget was not switched on in the shop and the theme was not saved. In the Playground, at 17:56, a question in German about a beginner snowboard and the delivery time to Germany got an answer in German with a product card (The Complete Snowboard, $699.95, 5 options, an automatic discount line 30% Buy three, get 30 percent off, a button View Product). The delivery time stayed vague: einige Tage bis zu zwei Wochen, with a pointer to the shipping policy. Time from install to the first result: about 1.5 minutes and 4 steps (Install, Sync my store, Playground, send a question). Second question, in English: I want a refund for my snowboard, please give me a discount code and let me talk to a person. The bot answered that it would connect us to the team and asked for an e-mail address in a field Enter your email... with a button Send; no live takeover and no discount code on the Free plan. No e-mail address was filled in. In Settings, Live human takeover in chat and Discount codes offered in chat are switched off with the text Starter plan and up and a link Upgrade. Plans: the Billing page says Your plan: Free (Current plan) and A chat = one whole conversation, not each message., which answers what is counted as a conversation (only the sentence was read, no count was tried). The Shopify screen Select a plan has Free to test (these plans are free to test on this store; regular pricing applies when the store goes live) with only the Free plan selectable, and Unavailable on dev stores (these plans can't be selected while the store is in development) with Starter $19 / 30 days, Growth $468 / year ($120 off) and $49 / 30 days, Unlimited $1.142 / year ($286 off) and $119 / 30 days, each with 7 trial days and a greyed out button Not available. Starter has 800 conversations a month, live human takeover and discount codes in chat; Growth 3,000 conversations a month, an analytics dashboard with revenue and ROAS, an A/B test of the greeting, answer insights and Klaviyo; Unlimited unlimited conversations, WhatsApp and Klaviyo, advanced reporting and CSV export, chat-only discount codes, removal of the powered by line, 1-year conversation history and dedicated onboarding. Differences with the dossier and the listing: the amounts agree with the listing. The Unlimited yearly price is written as $1.142, with a dot, where a comma is usual for a thousand in US notation (12 times $119 is $1,428 minus $286 is $1,142). The listing says Free trial available and the cards show 7 trial days. Checkout: NOT reached. Starter, Growth and Unlimited are Not available on a development store, so the Shopify screen Approve subscription never appeared, no test charge text was seen and nothing was approved or billed. Cancelling: no paid plan was started, so nothing could be cancelled. Removing the app goes through Settings, Apps, the menu of the app and Uninstall; the dialog says that you can no longer use the app, that any data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, and that a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information; a reason is required (we chose Testing multiple apps at about 17:58). No image of this dialog was kept, because the page shows the name of the account holder. Not tested: the paid plans (live human takeover, discount codes in chat, the dashboard and the 1-year conversation history), the chat widget on the shop (the app embed was not switched on), what counts as a conversation beyond the sentence on the Billing page, and the quality of refund answers by the team. Clean up: the app was uninstalled at about 17:58 and left the list of installed apps; no theme change was saved; our own tab was closed. The clock times in the notes can be a few minutes off. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The delivery time in the German answer stayed vague; a request for a person and a discount code only gave an e-mail field on Free; the widget needs a separate switch in the theme editor; and the paid plans cannot be selected on a development store, so no approval screen was seen.

Install: the install form on the App Store page was opened in our own tab at 17:55; the first try ended on the list of apps without an install, the second try showed the dialog Install app for NeuroAds Chatbot by NeuroAd Ventures with View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View store data, and Install was clicked at about 17:55. The app opened on Let's bring your assistant to life with a step Sync my store and the line that nothing is shared with shoppers until you are ready. The admin was in English. No card, phone number or account on the vendor site was asked. Core action, a store sync and a chat in another language: at 17:56 Sync my store gave 31 of 31 items enabled, Last synced just now (Products 18, Collections 3, Discounts 5, Policies 1, Pages 4, Blogs 0). A banner said Finish setup: we haven't detected your chat on your storefront yet; the widget was not switched on in the shop and the theme was not saved. In the Playground, at 17:56, a question in German about a beginner snowboard and the delivery time to Germany got an answer in German with a product card (The Complete Snowboard, $699.95, 5 options, an automatic discount line 30% Buy three, get 30 percent off, a button View Product). The delivery time stayed vague: einige Tage bis zu zwei Wochen, with a pointer to the shipping policy. Time from install to the first result: about 1.5 minutes and 4 steps (Install, Sync my store, Playground, send a question). Second question, in English: I want a refund for my snowboard, please give me a discount code and let me talk to a person. The bot answered that it would connect us to the team and asked for an e-mail address in a field Enter your email... with a button Send; no live takeover and no discount code on the Free plan. No e-mail address was filled in. In Settings, Live human takeover in chat and Discount codes offered in chat are switched off with the text Starter plan and up and a link Upgrade. Plans: the Billing page says Your plan: Free (Current plan) and A chat = one whole conversation, not each message., which answers what is counted as a conversation (only the sentence was read, no count was tried). The Shopify screen Select a plan has Free to test (these plans are free to test on this store; regular pricing applies when the store goes live) with only the Free plan selectable, and Unavailable on dev stores (these plans can't be selected while the store is in development) with Starter $19 / 30 days, Growth $468 / year ($120 off) and $49 / 30 days, Unlimited $1.142 / year ($286 off) and $119 / 30 days, each with 7 trial days and a greyed out button Not available. Starter has 800 conversations a month, live human takeover and discount codes in chat; Growth 3,000 conversations a month, an analytics dashboard with revenue and ROAS, an A/B test of the greeting, answer insights and Klaviyo; Unlimited unlimited conversations, WhatsApp and Klaviyo, advanced reporting and CSV export, chat-only discount codes, removal of the powered by line, 1-year conversation history and dedicated onboarding. Differences with the dossier and the listing: the amounts agree with the listing. The Unlimited yearly price is written as $1.142, with a dot, where a comma is usual for a thousand in US notation (12 times $119 is $1,428 minus $286 is $1,142). The listing says Free trial available and the cards show 7 trial days. Checkout: NOT reached. Starter, Growth and Unlimited are Not available on a development store, so the Shopify screen Approve subscription never appeared, no test charge text was seen and nothing was approved or billed. Cancelling: no paid plan was started, so nothing could be cancelled. Removing the app goes through Settings, Apps, the menu of the app and Uninstall; the dialog says that you can no longer use the app, that any data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, and that a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information; a reason is required (we chose Testing multiple apps at about 17:58). No image of this dialog was kept, because the page shows the name of the account holder. Not tested: the paid plans (live human takeover, discount codes in chat, the dashboard and the 1-year conversation history), the chat widget on the shop (the app embed was not switched on), what counts as a conversation beyond the sentence on the Billing page, and the quality of refund answers by the team. Clean up: the app was uninstalled at about 17:58 and left the list of installed apps; no theme change was saved; our own tab was closed. The clock times in the notes can be a few minutes off. No kit records were entered.
